# Axiogen — Creative Engineering Studio & Digital Experience Agency

> Axiogen (team.axiogen.in) is a premier Creative Engineering Studio and Digital Product Agency crafting high-performance web applications, enterprise software, AI solutions, and digital growth engines.

## Core Services

- [High-Performance Web Development](https://team.axiogen.in/#services): Custom Next.js 15, React, and WebGL web applications built for speed, technical SEO, and conversion.
- [ClinicOS & Medical Software](https://team.axiogen.in/#services): Complete electronic health record (EHR), clinic queue, patient management, and e-prescription software suite.
- [School ERP & EdTech Solutions](https://team.axiogen.in/#services): Comprehensive educational institution platforms managing student records, fees, report cards, and parent portals.
- [SEO & Digital Growth Engineering](https://team.axiogen.in/#services): Technical SEO, local search optimization, Google Business Profile ranking, and automated organic lead generation.
- [WhatsApp Automation & Messaging](https://team.axiogen.in/#services): Subscriptionless Baileys & Cloud API automated lead dispatch, customer support, and instant follow-ups.
- [Custom Enterprise Software & Inventory POS](https://team.axiogen.in/#services): Tailored B2B ERP, inventory tracking, POS systems, and automated operational workflows.
- [AI & Machine Learning Engineering](https://team.axiogen.in/#services): Fine-tuned LLMs, RAG knowledge bases, predictive telemetry, and autonomous AI voice/chat agents.

## Featured Software & Case Studies

- [SEOHub Pro](https://seohubpro.vercel.app): All-in-one enterprise SEO auditing platform featuring crawl analysis, keyword research via Gemini AI, and PageSpeed diagnostics.
- [Axiogen ClinicOS](https://github.com/axiogenai/axiogen-clinicos): Healthcare & clinic management suite with patient queuing, medical records, and billing engine.
- [Axiogen Digitize](https://github.com/axiogenai/axiogen-digitize): 17-stage AI Document Intelligence platform for automated OCR, table extraction, and B2B SaaS data parsing.
- [CodeMind AI](https://github.com/axiogenai/codemind-ai): Autonomous multi-language codebase reverse engineering, structural analysis & intelligence platform.
- [TruthLens Pro](https://truth-lenspro.vercel.app): AI-powered forensic fake news detection platform with image manipulation heatmaps and spread risk prediction.
- [Invenscope](https://invenscope.vercel.app): AI patent analyzer evaluating novelty using vector embeddings and cross-registry analysis.
- [RansomGuard AI](https://team.axiogen.in/#work): Real-time ransomware detection and response engine powered by watchdog traps and ML ensembles.
- [HMEMS SchoolSite Pro](https://github.com/axiogenai/hmems): Educational institution management platform with academic records and notice administration.
- [Maison Velours](https://github.com/axiogenai/maison-velours): Luxury e-commerce store featuring interactive digital showcases and seamless checkout.

## Technical Architecture & Tech Stack

- **Frontend Core**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, WebGL shaders.
- **Backend & AI**: Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, PyTorch, Groq Llama-3.3 70B, LangChain, Supabase PostgreSQL, Redis.
- **Security & Infrastructure**: Docker, Kubernetes, WAF protection, JWT SessionWarden, Cloudflare CDN.
